calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of three-day median-relative returns, activated only when at least 60 percent of tradable assets have negative five-day returns and scaled linearly through 90 percent downside breadth. Positive values favor recent relative losers during broad stress.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in all tested regimes: 2020-2022 0.0940431 (37 dates), 2023-2024 0.0807179 (18 dates), 2025-2027 0.0822810 (18 dates). The 5-day decay estimate has only one valid date and is not reliable; 10-day IC is supportive. The small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
